policy.examples: Small, versioned, analysis-ready slices in the workshop bucket make the starter notebooks reliable.
policy.exploration: Broader regional and temporal collections remain in Cloud Storage and are subset before loading.
policy.direct: Very large public archives remain at their authoritative cloud/API source; the workshop supplies discovery and subsetting helpers instead of copying entire archives.

datasets.title: TEMPO + EPA AQS matched Northeast case
datasets.source_access: The workshop copy is read-only; provenance manifests point to the NASA and EPA sources.
datasets.notes: Six TEMPO V04 scans from 14:06–19:06 UTC and same-day regional hourly AQS observations.

datasets.title: July 2026 Great Lakes and Northeast wildfire-smoke case
datasets.provider: NASA, NOAA, and US EPA AirNow
datasets.format: TEMPO Zarr plus context/cases/2026-07-16-smoke CSV and GeoJSON
datasets.source_access: Workshop extracts are read-only; the manifest records each NASA TEMPO, NOAA HMS, and AirNow source.
datasets.notes: Six TEMPO V04 scans, NOAA HMS visible-smoke polygons/fire detections, and seven days of preliminary AirNow daily PM2.5. AirNow is not regulatory AQS data.

datasets.title: NASA TEMPO Level 3 NO2
datasets.source_access: NASA Earthdata login is required for preparation-time granule downloads.
datasets.notes: The event copy contains quality-screening variables and regional/time subsets, not the entire mission archive.

datasets.title: EPA Air Quality System hourly observations
datasets.source_access: Public bulk downloads; recent-year archives can lag the current date.
datasets.notes: Hourly NO2, O3, and PM2.5 are available as notebook-sized cases and broader monthly partitions, avoiding a full national-archive download.

datasets.title: NOAA Global Forecast System
datasets.source_access: Public cloud archive; Earth2Studio's GFS datasource is the supported notebook path.
datasets.notes: Inputs are cached per attendee; request only the times and variables needed.

datasets.title: NOAA High-Resolution Rapid Refresh
datasets.notes: Do not recursively download the archive. Select a run, forecast hour, region, and variables.

datasets.title: NASA Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2
datasets.source_access: Discover through NASA CMR/STAC; Earthdata authentication may be required for asset access.
datasets.notes: A seven-band, 30 m HLS L30 cutout over the SERC region is staged for 4 June 2026. Mirror selected tiles/time windows into GCS because source assets can be region- and credential-bound.

datasets.title: NOAA Hazard Mapping System fire and smoke
datasets.format: GeoJSON smoke polygons and CSV fire detections
datasets.source_access: Public daily archives; no attendee credential required.
datasets.notes: HMS polygons are analyst interpretations of visible satellite smoke and are not surface concentration measurements.

datasets.title: NASA FIRMS active fire detections
datasets.source_access: Recent API access uses a MAP_KEY; archive downloads use Earthdata services.
datasets.notes: Keep credentials out of images and notebooks; publish reviewed case extracts to the workshop bucket.

datasets.title: USGS National Water Information System
datasets.notes: Use bounded sites, parameters, and time windows; cache useful workshop queries in GCS.

datasets.title: NOAA CO-OPS tides and currents
datasets.workshop_status: real Annapolis case plus live helper
datasets.notes: The staged case contains six-minute observed water levels and matching astronomical predictions for 25 May–2 June 2026. Annapolis is regional context, not a GCReW marsh measurement.

datasets.title: EPA Clean Air Status and Trends Network
datasets.notes: A high-priority addition for wetland and nitrogen-deposition teams.

datasets.title: ForestGEO and investigator-provided site data
datasets.source_access: Dataset terms and investigator approval apply; public-bucket access must not be assumed.
datasets.notes: Place approved collections under a controlled bucket prefix with provenance and terms, not in the public image.
